title: Receipt-declared tolerance does not enlarge the window (content claims delta_s huge; confirmation late)
scenario: The receipt carries its own (adversarial) tolerances; the verifier must use only its catalog delta and reject the late confirmation.
base: honest bundle (A-a), issued with chosen content
choices: Where a V1 receipt can 'declare' a tolerance: the bundle never supplies delta (profile 2.2). The only signed free field is common.content, which the verifier does not read. This vector puts it there; E10-TMP-09 puts it in the unsigned issuer_record.

needs: As E10-TMP-01; the content is ordinary client content (L0-compatible on the issue side).

subcases.construction: TEST issue, content {TEST, delta_s: '999999999', epsilon_s: '999999999'}, times {h*+5: TB+DELTA+1}, adversarial
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*) of the fixture's own receipt proof and headers (a_sig and receipt_anchor as stamped; rows 11.1-11.4 pass); U = 7200 + max nTime(h*..h*+5) (A10.1.1)
